page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2g.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs derived from 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The processor includes a 33 MB L3 cache and supports AVX and AVX-512F instruction sets. The server is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core, and includes a bundled 959 GB local SSD storage volume. Network connectivity is rated at a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate that the ecs.i2g.2xlarge exhibits modest computational and memory performance. In stress-ng and Geekbench tests, both single-core and multi-core CPU performance fall into the bottom 25% tier. Memory read bandwidth is also weak, though large-block write bandwidth reaches average levels. Cryptographic and database operations, such as Redis SET and Passmark database tests, score in the bottom 25%. However, the CPU demonstrates average performance in Passmark CPU and extended instruction tests, as well as average prompt processing and text generation speeds when running small 135M parameter language models.

From a resource density perspective, the inclusion of a dedicated CPU allocation and a substantial 959 GB local SSD provides a solid hardware profile for storage-centric workloads. However, the lower-tier CPU and memory benchmark results represent a tradeoff, making this instance less suitable for compute-intensive tasks or large-scale database operations. It is best utilized for workloads that require local high-capacity SSD storage but have moderate processing demands, such as local file caching, basic web serving, or small-scale data processing.
